outcome_condition: Proposed overall assumes all other required obligations pass; no current runner support is implied.

facts: The normal canonical gate subject is already-known committed target H/tree T; a durable plan challenge precedes its invocation.
An authenticated owner-approved external producer supplies complete coverage and actual control witnesses, with an accepted mechanism establishing consumed inputs beyond endpoint equality.
Actual index equals T before and after; the gate naturally completes with zero exit inside its explicitly enforced approved budget.
cases.reason: A future importer can accept the configured complete attestation without claiming it executed the gate.

facts: Actual staged tree I differs from requested committed tree T.
A real staged-index gate succeeds for I while unstaged content also differs.
cases.reason: Do not promote an index result to a different committed subject or demand a duplicate run solely for import.

facts: A generated snapshot index contains public tracked files.
The required gate consumes the operator's actual staged index and approved private-input readiness.
cases.reason: Matching some tree bytes does not establish actual index or private-input coverage.

facts: The canonical gate needs an ordered set of new commits and ref-input records.
An invocation provides no ref input and selects no commits but exits zero.
cases.reason: Zero work is not successful coverage of the required commit set.

facts: A receipt passed with current-main reference R1.
The accepted gate depends on that reference; import observes R2.
cases.reason: Receipt age alone cannot preserve evidence whose consumed ref changed.

facts: The accepted registry explicitly makes a local subgate conditional.
Its approved selector and complete immutable inputs witness false; no shared mandatory gate is removed.
cases.reason: Report not-applicable separately; never claim the command ran.

facts: A head-side selector/config attempts to mark a required gate optional; no accepted result exists for this gate.
It differs from the accepted selector/rules.
cases.reason: Reject the new authority; any other valid bound required failure still causes fail.

facts: A whole uncached gate is required.
Only a short filtered/cached subset is attested; equivalence for the complete input/dependent set is absent.
cases.reason: Do not relabel the subset or split as an equivalent full gate.

facts: The unchanged current runner cannot execute this gate within 600 seconds.
Only a future explicitly adopted external route permits 1200 seconds; its trusted producer attests a complete 840-second gate and cleanup.
cases.reason: This is a proposed new capability, never an override or existing feature.

facts: The declared route budget is 1200 seconds.
Actual elapsed time is 1510 seconds even though exit is zero.
cases.reason: The importer cannot retroactively enforce or extend the budget.

facts: A valid context-bound required command is witnessed naturally completing with nonzero exit before output cleanup is interrupted.
A child holds output open; timeout, cancellation and cleanup facts are incomplete.
cases.reason: Preserve command failure and each incomplete output/cleanup axis.

facts: An external job is killed without a final exit witness.
An owned helper may remain; no cleanup receipt exists.
cases.reason: Inspect/reconcile before retry; an importer cannot kill an already external job.

facts: The planned public source snapshot is T.
A preprovisioned interpreter imports an editable first-party module from an older checkout O.
cases.reason: Environment availability and a zero exit cannot bind the result to T.

facts: The accepted effects allow only preprovisioned offline dependencies.
The canonical command provisions a different environment using an unapproved network effect.
cases.reason: A receipt cannot authorize the past effect or trigger a download/retry.

facts: A required actual-index privacy gate also needs an owner-approved private input.
The source-only run lacks it and reports a skip.
cases.reason: Neither a public fixture nor a manual assertion that tests exited zero supplies the private check.

facts: Accepted policy requires enforced tracked-source tool/path/network permissions.
A route is described as read-only, but actual enforcement is unknown and no mechanism witness exists.
cases.reason: Keep required, actual and manual objects distinct; do not invent enforced=true.

facts: An authorized route covers public source only.
A proposed local viewer would return private-derived pixels into hosted context.
cases.reason: Do not perform the disclosure or fabricate a review record.

facts: A receipt belongs to a consumed plan or carries only its own expected digest/producer claim.
No accepted outside-target provenance binds it to the new plan.
cases.reason: Digest consistency, timestamps and identity strings cannot establish authority.

facts: One independent route has a valid bound required failure.
Another record is malformed, duplicated or conflicts with its required route.
cases.reason: Reject bad evidence without choosing the last duplicate or erasing a validated failure.

facts: The historical accepted base has no accepted toolkit config/lock.
A current corrective review does not attest an unavailable required historical pre-code critique.
cases.reason: A later separate bootstrap and current review cannot manufacture historical evidence.

facts: Public unit checks pass for an invented analysis experiment.
Its existing acceptance requires representative output/human evaluation that remains pending; no new reference-label requirement is added.
cases.reason: Keep uncertainty and automatic/manual judgments separate; test counts do not establish domain accuracy.

facts: An actual index/file/ref changes during execution and is restored before the final snapshot.
Only pre/post endpoint equality exists; no accepted consumed-input identity mechanism is demonstrated.
cases.reason: Do not infer the bytes actually consumed from equal endpoint observations.

facts: A deadline wrapper emits 124 or 137 after terminating work.
No witness establishes a naturally completed required command failure.
cases.reason: An unexplained nonzero or signal status is not proof of a completed functional failure.

facts: The accepted canonical gate explicitly permits cache equivalence rather than requiring an uncached run.
The original complete result identity, producer, context, outcome and completion time remain intact and within the accepted finite cache age.
A newly challenged canonical assessment establishes complete equivalence and all volatile consumed inputs with the accepted mechanism; import is inside its 900-second maximum window.
cases.reason: Label cached reuse and preserve original provenance; never call this a new uncached full run.

facts: A producer wraps an old cached success in a fresh challenge/timestamp.
The original completion is expired or omitted and no genuine accepted current equivalence assessment exists.
cases.reason: A new attestation cannot renew cache age or supply missing current coverage.

facts: A real pre-commit gate saw staged tree T with earlier HEAD, intended message and refs.
A later committed target also has tree T, but those consumed phase inputs differ; no accepted promotion equivalence exists.
cases.reason: Known-target import cannot silently promote pre-commit history even with equal trees.

facts: Envelope bytes are invalid or unreadable.
Some untrusted fragment appears to describe a failure, but no complete common context/route has been validated.
cases.reason: Do not salvage a claimed result from invalid bytes; separately persisted valid failures remain intact.

facts: A bound required natural failure and its accepted digest/consumption state were atomically persisted.
Import is interrupted while processing another route; retry presents the same or a conflicting receipt in the intact same-context local record.
cases.reason: Resume/return the stored result without rerun or overwrite; do not claim global replay protection across lost state.

facts: The command appears to finish with zero exit inside the declared budget.
Policy requires an enforced deadline/cleanup boundary, but its actual mechanism is unknown.
cases.reason: Elapsed facts alone cannot establish required enforcement.

facts: An intact same-context route record contains an accepted success.
A separately authenticated and validated receipt establishes a naturally completed required failure for that same context.
cases.reason: Keep original history immutable, retain the valid failure and incomplete conflict, and never ignore a known failure merely because a slot was consumed.
